title: Shibbydex (v2.0) News: Announcements (Version  2.0)
description: Welcome to the next version of the Shibbydex! Listen in as I detail the new features that are included in this complete overhaul of the backend of the site, and what kinds of updates you can expect in the near future. A brand new Playlist page has been added for Beta supporters. Revamped haptics gives you more control than ever. The site should be quicker, more reliable and smoother Brand new Cum Calendars are on their way! And lots lots more... Remember to please report bugs and issues while we work out the kinks. It really helps.
author: Mistress Shibby
